name: Greater Bergen County YMCA Harriman Day Camps (Kahagon, Oratam, TeenVenture)
operator_name: Greater Bergen County YMCA (Metropolitan YMCA of the Oranges)
description_short: YMCA lakeside day camps on Lake Kanawauke in Harriman State Park, NY, with a daily bus from the New Milford YMCA Program Center: Kahagon for grades K and 1, Oratam for grades 2 to 7, and TeenVenture with climbing, campouts and boating for grades 7 to 9.
refund_policy_summary: The down payment is non-refundable; the balance is due May 15, and changes within 30 days of camp cost $50.
swim_waterfront_notes: Lake Kanawauke with certified lifeguards; Kahagon campers learn in a protected 3 foot deep area; Oratam swims twice a day (one lesson, one free swim).
notes: Kahagon and Oratam $993 per 2 week session; TeenVenture $1,056. 5 percent down payment per session. Camp 8 am to 6 pm; the bus leaves the New Milford Program Center at 8:30 am and returns by 6 pm. Before care 7 to 8 am for a fee (TeenVenture $38.50 a week); no aftercare at Kahagon. Families pack lunch and two snacks. Any family can register; Y members get the member rate and others pay the community rate, and the page does not say which rate is shown. Registration opens December 1, 2026 (priority for 2026 campers to December 18). The Y also runs Summer Quest at the New Milford Program Center and the Camp Michikamau sleepaway camp.
